summary: A mixed day dominated by retail earnings and market movements. Trent Q2 revenue grew 23% YoY to Rs 5,788 crore with Zudio crossing 1,000 stores, while NSE shares fell below IPO price, wiping Rs 41,000 crore in market value.

bullets.text: Trent Q2 standalone revenue rose 23% YoY to Rs 5,788 crore; Zudio fashion chain crossed 1,000-store milestone.
NSE shares slipped below IPO price after listing-day rally, erasing nearly Rs 41,000 crore in peak market value.
Jio Platforms plans IPO launch on October 21, according to sources familiar with Reliance's subsidiary plans.
Supreme Court closed Constitution Bench reference case on legislative privilege and free speech without substantive judgment.
DeepSeek to raise at least $12 billion (₹80 billion) in Tencent-backed funding round, Bloomberg reported.
